correctness.rationale: Reconstructed per-index V_i: fixed η(i) contributes Cov(F,V_i)=(n−f)/[n(n−1)]; moved η(i) contributes 2f/[n(n−1)(n−2)], using Σ_b |{i,η(i)} ∩ {b,η(b)}|=4. Sum over f fixed and n−f moved indices gives f(n−f)/[(n−1)(n−2)]. Independent complete enumeration for every η,Π∈S_n for n=3,4,5 matches rational covariance. Boundary f=0/ n gives zero; n−1 is impossible, and n=2 excluded. F=n implies Π=id and Cη=n; for η fixed-point-free nonidentity Cη variable hence uncorrelated not independent. Full proof is counting, not finite extrapolation.
